disclaimer.en: This dossier prioritizes review using the evidence available as of the displayed date. The model estimates the chance of first US generic approval. Qualified experts must verify Thai rights and assess freedom to operate (FTO) against the claims, product, jurisdiction and current legal status. This dossier is neither a legal opinion nor an FTO opinion.
